lisbon.name: Lisbon
lisbon.best_months: April to June, or September and October
lisbon.notes: Hilly and walkable. Tram 28 is crowded by mid-morning; go early.

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.best_months: late March to early April for blossoms, or November for autumn leaves
kyoto.notes: Fly into Osaka Kansai; the train to Kyoto takes about 75 minutes.

reykjavik.name: Reykjavik
reykjavik.best_months: June to August for long days, or October to March for the northern lights
reykjavik.notes: Weather changes fast. Book the Blue Lagoon ahead.
